title: Te Tangata i Peia i te Māra
intro: I noho tētahi mea ngaro i roto i ngā taumata teitei o te ao hanga, he mea tata atu ki te Atua i tā te tini e taea te whakaaro. Heoi, ka pū te whakapehapeha, ā, kotahi noa te mahi whakakeke i whakarerekē i te huarahi o te ao. Ināianei, ka kopikopiko tēnei mea hei hoariri, e kōrero pōhewa ana, e whakatakoto mahere ana kia tae mai rā anō tētahi rā kua oatitia. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei tangata kua hinga?
clues: I roto ahau i te hunga i tata rawa ki te aroaro o te Atua i mua, i whakanekehia ake ki runga ake i te nuinga o ngā mea hanga.
I hangaia ahau i te mea werawera, ehara i te mea i hangaia i te oneone, i te uku rānei.
I te whakahauatanga kia piko ki mua i tētahi mea hou, i whakakahore ahau — i akiakihia e taku i whakapono ai ko tōku ake hiranga.
I peia ahau, i kanga, engari i tukuna mai he wā whakatā kia tae rā anō ki tētahi wā kua whakaritea.
I oati ahau ki te arahi ke i te tini o te tangata e taea e au, me te whakatata atu ki te uri o Arama i nga taha katoa.
Ko ahau te hoariri tuwhera o te tangata katoa, e whakatakoto whakaaro ana, e kōrero hāhā ana, ā, tae noa ki te mutunga kua whakaritea.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
